input.summary: The evidence indicates that Prof. Suresh Kulkarni (67) was put under a fake "digital arrest" from 03 to 05 Oct 2026. Calls came from courier number 7303518246 and from 8969204117/ConnectX 'cbi.vikram.rathore'. Under that pressure he made three RTGS transfers himself, totalling Rs 38,50,000, to Rohit Pawar's Konkan SFB account (TXN T00001/T00003/T00005). Rohit had rented out his account to Imran Shaikh for Rs 15,000 ('acct rent', TXN T00021). Rohit's phone forwarded the bank OTPs to 8969204117 seconds before each outward IMPS. Rohit's account was emptied within minutes: Rs 21.4L went to Imran, Rs 8.6L to Bapi Mondal and Rs 8.4L to Hemant Saini. Imran's tower data contradicts his Malegaon alibi. He took out Rs 2.97L by card at a Nashik ATM on 05-Oct, withdrew Rs 9L by self-cheque on 06-Oct, sent Rs 9.4L to Gulshan Traders, and called Sameer Ansari after both cash withdrawals. Both scam SIMs ran in handsets seized from Sameer Ansari's flat in Nashik. The 'Vikram Rathore' handset also carried Sameer's own KYC-verified SIM before and after the fraud, and the forensic preliminary report found the ConnectX impersonation account, fake CBI ID, fake warrant and the forwarded OTPs on it. The nephew, Anil Kulkarni, whom the victim's wife suspected, was in Bengaluru throughout and had no contact with the scam numbers. The case is substantially made out but has gaps to fix first: s.63 certificates, the final forensic report, Imran's seizure being witnessed only by police, and corroboration of Rohit's admissions.
